scholarships.name: Country-related cooperation programme with Argentina (ALEARG) **• DAAD**
scholarships.description: Graduates, doctoral candidates and postdocs receive a scholarship to complete a study or research stay or a Master's, postgraduate or doctoral degree in Germany.
scholarships.deadlineText: **Applications can only be submitted via the online portal of the Argentinian Ministry of Education. Please follow this link: <https://www.argentina.gob.ar/educacion/campusargentinaglobal>**
scholarships.sourceQuote: Graduates, doctoral candidates, postdocs or teachers at universities in Argentina or researchers at publicly funded institutions of Argentine nationality usually up to the age of 36.
